summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests engineered natural killer (NK) cells that carry a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) aimed at IL13Ra and EGFvIII, with IL-21 secretion and deleted TGF-BetaR2 and NR3C1, in recurrent glioblastoma. The record lists delivery by Ommaya reservoir, intravenous, intra-tumoral and intra-arterial routes; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1 study whose stated aim is to find the best way to give NK cells.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células asesinas naturales (NK) modificadas que tienen un receptor de antígeno quimérico (CAR) dirigido a IL13Ra y EGFvIII, con secreción de IL-21 y eliminación de TGF-BetaR2 y NR3C1, en glioblastoma recurrente. El registro indica administración por reservorio de Ommaya, intravenosa, intratumoral e intraarterial; la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de fase 1 cuyo objetivo declarado es encontrar la mejor forma de administrar las células NK.
who_for: Recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma, gliosarcoma, or recurrent IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma.
Prior radiation and temozolomide therapy received.
Single tumor no larger than 5 cm in greatest diameter.
not_for: Prior interstitial brachytherapy, implanted chemotherapy, or local injection or convection enhanced delivery.
Investigational agent or device use within 4 weeks of last dose.
Known HIV, HTLV, active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
Multifocal disease, brainstem or spinal cord tumor, or gliomatous meningitis.
